journey.name: Starter: wallet pill renders
journey.description: The SDK's wallet pill must mount in the host app's top bar on a cold start with no sigil. If WalletAppShell stops mounting it, or it throws during composition on a wallet-less session, the dApp loses its entire wallet surface while the rest of the app still renders — invisible to the SDK's own tests, because it only happens once a real app hosts the panel.
